_readme: Printosky Office, Nattika — back-office / transcription box on the same 192.168.1.x LAN as the counter. store_id MUST be declared here: it is LAN-exempt, otherwise the subnet rule would sweep this machine into PRINTK. It shares the counter's Epson, so poll_printers is false — two boxes polling one printer double-counts the counters and imports every printer job twice.
